caveats: A row is an instruction name, not an encoding or a semantic variant.
Table A-1's compact-form footnote sits in the C64x+ column; compact C674x encodings must be confirmed against the Appendix C-H 16-bit maps.
Instructions with no Table B-1 unit execute on no .L/.M/.S/.D unit (for example NOP and IDLE); see Appendix H.
Pseudo-operations and assembler aliases documented outside Table A-1 are not included.
